Class DerivativeAccumulator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.engine.DerivativeAccumulator
public final class DerivativeAccumulator extends Object
Cellular state derivative accumulator for single-pass Kernel Fusion.

Fuses multi-engine rate-of-change updates across contiguous DOD tensors in a single memory pass, eliminating redundant memory scans and maximizing CPU cache locality.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
